thread:
arjun: starting thread for the v8-int4 staged rollout. flipped 1% at 07:40 UTC. main ask: validate our composite gating (MRR, entropy, schema-fidelity) behaves for variant promotion.
claire: initial telemetry: P95 -27%, global MRR -0.8%, but schema-fidelity on structured-output slice -6.3% (>=3k tokens). entropy score up +0.9.
oscar: saw structured-output drift where field order changes and some keys get collapsed. samples: s3://redwood-evals/1758889000/v8-int4/struct-diffs.txt
arjun: current auto-fallback: any slice MRR <= -5% OR schema-fidelity <= -5% OR hallucination >=2% abs -> rollback. that seems straightforward but maybe too coarse for structured outputs.
marco: suggestion: introduce a composite-watchdog that combines weighted signals and enforces a "silent rollback" cooldown for canaries <2% traffic to avoid flapping. e.g., compute composite = 0.5*MRR_delta_norm + 0.3*schema_fidelity_norm + 0.2*entropy_norm; trigger if composite <= -0.6 sustained 20m.
claire: I like that. also: for structured-output we should prioritize schema_fidelity with a multiplier when keys are reordered or missing (high-severity). propose a hard rule: missing-key rate >=1.5% absolute triggers immediate rollback regardless of traffic.
oscar: technically many of these issues look like tokenizer-postprocess changes after quant (key separators trimmed). I'll run a tokenizer-preserving eval (escape sequences preserved) and diff.
deploy-bot: [ab_report] v8-int4@1%: p95 -27%, median -34%, global MRR -0.8%, struct-schema_fidelity -6.3%, entropy +0.9. report: s3://redwood-evals/1758889000/v8-int4/report.html
arjun: operational patch: set canary to 0.5% observe 60m, disable auto-rollback for composite until traffic >=2% but keep missing-key immediate rollback active at any traffic level. create shadow sampling 5% for structured-output slice.
claire: config I'm applying:
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v8-int4 --traffic 0.5% --observe 60m --auto-fallback "composite_enabled=false" --notes "struct-output watchdog warmup"
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v8-int4 --traffic 5% --mode sampling --slices structured-output
rwctl watch add --slice structured-output --metrics schema_fidelity,missing_key_rate,entropy --window 60m --sustain 20m
```
marco: I'll implement the composite-watchdog in our monitor service as a temporary rule. composite weights: MRR 0.5, schema 0.4 (high severity bump for missing_key), entropy 0.1. sustain 20m threshold -0.6.
oscar: running tokenizer-preserving eval now; if it reproduces, we can try adjusting post-tokenize detokenizer heuristics or switch projection quant scaling back to asymmetric for separators. ETA 45m.
eng-oncall: noted. pager rules: only page if missing_key_rate >=1.5% abs OR global MRR <= -7% OR hallucination >=4% abs sustained 10m. Otherwise slack alerts in this thread.
arjun: agreed. if shadow sampling confirms structured-output failures we'll pause promotion at 2% and open a triage. Otherwise if shadow is clean after detokenizer tweak, we promote to 2% with composite watchdog enabled.
deploy-bot: [action] rollout rlt-1758889000 created by claire: canary 0.5% observe=60m auto-fallback composite_disabled shadow=5% structured-output.
arjun: thanks. short replies only. post new telemetry or explicit rollback/proceed calls. reconvene 08:45 UTC or earlier if deploy-bot flags an action.
